triage.reason: This Government Resolution amends eligibility criteria, beneficiary age limit (from 60 to 65 years), ineligibility conditions, and required documentation for the Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana scheme.

changes.summary: Maximum age for beneficiaries is raised from 60 to 65 completed years.

citation.quote_original: हकमान वयाची 21 वषे पूणण व कमाल वयाची 65 वषण पूणण होईपयंत.
citation.quote_english: From completion of the minimum age of 21 years until completion of the maximum age of 65 years.

changes.summary: One unmarried woman per family becomes eligible, in addition to married, widowed, divorced, abandoned and destitute women.

citation.quote_original: तसेच त्या कु टूंबातील के वळ एक अहववाहहत महहला.
citation.quote_english: as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

changes.summary: Only one unmarried woman per family can receive the benefit, so an unmarried woman is ineligible if another unmarried woman in the family already receives it.

citation.quote_original: तसेच त्या कु टूंबातील के वळ एक अहववाहहत महहला.
citation.quote_english: as well as only one unmarried woman from that family.

changes.summary: Contract, outsourced and volunteer workers in the family (with income up to Rs 2.5 lakh) no longer disqualify the applicant; only regular employees and pensioners do.

citation.quote_original: रु.2.50 लाखापयंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कायणरत असलेले कमणचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आहण कं त्राटी कमणचारी पात्र ठरतील.
citation.quote_english: Employees working through outside agencies, volunteer workers and contract employees with income up to Rs 2.50 lakh will be eligible.

changes.summary: A woman receiving Rs 1,500 or more per month from other government schemes is now disqualified; previously only more than Rs 1,500 disqualified her.

citation.quote_original: दरमहा रु.1,500/- ककवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त रक्तकमेचा लाभ घेत असेल.
citation.quote_english: is receiving a benefit of Rs 1,500/- per month or more than that.

changes.summary: The disqualification for families jointly owning more than five acres of farm land is removed.

citation.quote_original: येहिल अपात्रतेची अट वगळण्यात येत आहे.
citation.quote_english: The disqualification condition here is being deleted.

ambiguities.question: For contract, outsourced and volunteer workers, is the Rs 2.5 lakh income limit the employee's own income or the whole family's income?
readings: It is the family's annual income, which the existing income ceiling already enforces, so these workers are simply no longer disqualified.
It is the individual worker's own income, so a family could have total income above Rs 2.5 lakh and still qualify on this point.

citation.quote_original: रु.2.50 लाखापयंत उत्पन्न असलेले बाह्य यंत्रणाद्वारे कायणरत असलेले कमणचारी, स्वयंसेवी कामगार आहण कं त्राटी कमणचारी पात्र ठरतील.

ambiguities.question: Are yellow and orange ration card holders exempt only from submitting an income certificate, or also from the Rs 2.5 lakh family income ceiling?
readings: Only the document is waived, and the income ceiling still applies, with the ration card taken as proof of income.
The ceiling itself is waived for these ration card holders, so they qualify whatever their income.

Row 1 states the age group as '21 to 65', and the glossary treats the upper age as inclusive (that glossary entry still needs human confirmation). citation.quote_original: 3. योजनेचे लाभािी:- महाराष्ट्र राज्यातील 21 ते 65 या वषण वयोगटातील हववाहहत, हवधवा, घटस्फोहटत, पहरत्यक्तत्या आहण हनराधार महहला

citation.quote_english: A financial benefit of Rs 1,500 per month will be given from 1 July 2024.

verifier_cases.name: Typical eligible widow aged 50

citation.quote_original: अ.क्र. (3) हकमान वयाची 21 वषे पूणण व कमाल वयाची 60 वषण पूणण होईपयंत.
citation.quote_english: Item (3): minimum age of 21 years completed and up to the completion of a maximum age of 60 years.

resolutions.explanation: Both agents agree she is eligible. Rs 1,499 is below the new 'Rs 1,500 per month or more' disqualification in clause 5(4), and the rulebook uses the strict comparison other_scheme_monthly_inr < 1500. The only disagreement is the amount: the verifier expects Rs 1,500 and the rulebook returns Rs 1. That is exactly Rs 1,500 minus Rs 1,499, so the rulebook is paying a top-up (the difference) rather than the full amount. This GR of 03.07.2024 is an amending order. It changes only the rows listed in its table (A1 to A8) plus sections B to E. It does not touch the form of the benefit in the original GR of 28.06.2024. That GR provides that a woman who already gets less than Rs 1,500 a month from another government scheme is paid the difference. Section D of this GR mentions 'Rs 1,500 per month from 1 July 2024', but only to set the start date and application deadline. It does not repeal the difference-payment rule. The verifier worked from the amending document alone and assumed the full Rs 1,500. The encoder correctly left the amount rule unchanged, and its skipped note says 'the monthly benefit amount of Rs 1,500 is unchanged'. Note for maintainers: the rulebook printout shows only monthly_benefit = 1500 and not the top-up formula. That hidden formula caused this confusion, so it should be shown explicitly (e.g. amount = monthly_benefit - other_scheme_monthly_inr, citing the 28.06.2024 GR). The 28.06.2024 GR is not attached here, so the exact wording of its difference-payment clause should be checked against that GR.
resolutions.glossary_entry:
## "शासन निर्णयामध्ये खालीलप्रमाणे सुधारणा" (the GR is amended as follows)
An amending GR changes only the clauses it lists. Every other provision of the original GR stays in force, including how the benefit amount is calculated (for example, paying only the difference when another scheme already pays less than Rs 1,500). When the amending GR merely repeats an amount, as in 'दरमहा रु.१,५००/-' in its deadline clause, that does not cancel a top-up rule in the original GR.
Source: GR 202407031335114330, opening of 'शासन निर्णय' and section ड; benefit form from GR 202406281814018230 (needs human confirmation of the exact clause).

## "शासन निर्णयामध्ये खालीलप्रमाणे सुधारणा" (the GR is amended as follows)
An amending GR changes only the clauses it lists. Every other provision of the original GR stays in force, including how the benefit amount is calculated (for example, paying only the difference when another scheme already pays less than Rs 1,500). When the amending GR merely repeats an amount, as in 'दरमहा रु.१,५००/-' in its deadline clause, that does not cancel a top-up rule in the original GR.
Source: GR 202407031335114330, opening of 'शासन निर्णय' and section ड; benefit form from GR 202406281814018230 (needs human confirmation of the exact clause).
